label: Mist configuration schema DNS semantics, frozen for the Guardian dns plug-in

source.object_types: snapshots/registry.py ORG_OBJECTS and SITE_OBJECTS, each resolved to its GET response schema

method: Every property whose name matches /dns/i, or whose description names DNS as a word, found recursively through $ref, allOf/oneOf/anyOf, additionalProperties and items. Sub-fields of a DNS-named object belong to that object. Path segment '*' matches one object key and '[]' one list index.

semantics.management_resolution: The device resolves names for its own management traffic with this setting.
semantics.client_resolution: Clients served by the device receive or are forced onto these DNS settings.
semantics.unverified: No single class is established by the cited schema text; the row stays uncovered.
